license_required.quote: Any person desiring to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy, surgery, or obstetrics in any of their branches in this state shall apply to the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners for a license.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners

name.value: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners
name.quote: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners

type.quote: Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners

age_minimum.quote: being at least eighteen years of age

degree_required.quote: graduated and received a diploma from a medical or osteopathic college approved by the board

accrediting_body.quote: approved by the board in accordance with rules adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26

required.quote: successful completion of a program as an intern or resident, or of equivalent service approved by the board, in a hospital approved by the board

duration.quote: for such time as the board requires by rule adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26

kind.quote: program as an intern or resident, or of equivalent service

exams.name: Written examination
exams.quote: passes an examination, determined by the board by rule adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26, to establish medical competence

renewal_fee_usd.quote: biennial fee set by the board, by rule promulgated pursuant to chapter 1-26, not exceeding the sum of four hundred dollars

available.quote: The Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners may, without examination, issue a license to any applicant holding a currently valid license or certificate issued to the applicant by the examining board of the District of Columbia, any state or territory of the United States, the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, or any province of Canada

requirements.value: Legal requirements of examining board at time of issuance must not be less than South Dakota's requirements at time of presentation; board may require oral or written examination and personal appearance
requirements.quote: if the legal requirements of the examining board at the time it issued the license or certificate were not less than those of this state at the time the license is presented for registration. However, the board may require the applicant to successfully pass either an oral or written examination and personally appear before the board

exists.quote: only the nine physician members and the representative of the public referenced in §36-4-1 may: (1)Participate in discussion on matters related to the licensure, practice, education, continuing education, investigation, and discipline of physicians

national_certification.quote: if the applicant is board-certified by a board of the American Board of Medical Specialties, the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners may waive this requirement

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices medicine, osteopathy, or any of the branches thereof without a license, certificate, or permit issued by the board is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: the Board of Examiners shall grant a license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine, surgery, and obstetrics in all of their branches, without limitations, in this state

is_mandatory.quote: No person required to be licensed, certificated, or permitted under the provisions of this chapter shall practice the person's profession in the State of South Dakota without such active license, certificate, or permit

title_protection.quote: to append or prefix the letters M.D., or D. O. or the title of Doctor or Dr. or Specialist or Osteopath or any other sign or appellation in a medical sense to one's name or to profess publicly to be a physician or surgeon

scope_protection.quote: to recommend, prescribe or direct for the use of any person any drug, medicine, apparatus, or other agency for the cure, relief or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body

disciplinary_grounds.description: Producing or aiding or abetting a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Producing or aiding or abetting a criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing cappers or steerers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing what is known as cappers or steerers

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fees on assurance that incurable disease can be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee on the assurance that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Untruthful or misleading advertising of medical business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of medical business in which untruthful or improbable statements are made or which are calculated to mislead or deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any criminal offense of the grade of felony, any conviction of a criminal offense arising out of the practice of medicine or osteopathy, or one in connection with any criminal offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habits of intemperance or drug addiction affecting practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habits of intemperance or drug addiction, calculated in the opinion of the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners to affect the licensee's practice of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report diseased or unsanitary conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusal or neglect to report the existence of a diseased or unsanitary condition to the proper health authorities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing habit-forming drugs improperly or in dangerous amounts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing intoxicants, narcotics, barbiturates, or other habit-forming drugs to any person in quantities and under circumstances making it apparent to the board that the prescription was not made for legitimate medicinal purposes or prescribing in a manner or in amounts calculated in the opinion of the board to endanger the well-being of an individual patient or the public in general

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting fees or giving consideration for furnishing patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Splitting fees or giving to any person furnishing a patient any portion of the fees received from the patient or paying or giving to any person consideration of any kind for furnishing a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose school of practice or professional degree
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to disclose one's school of practice or one's professional academic degree when using a professional title or designation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental disability rendering practice dangerous
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sustaining any physical or mental disability which renders the further practice of a licensee's profession dangerous

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with laws on keeping records of narcotics and drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with state or federal laws on keeping records regarding possessing and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying medical records or drug dispensing records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying the medical records of a patient or any official record regarding possession and dispensing of narcotics, barbiturates, and habit-forming drugs or regarding any phase of medical treatment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining license by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the board any license, certificate, or diploma which was obtained by fraud or deception practiced in passing a required examination or which was obtained by the giving of false statements or information on applying for the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illegally obtaining license through deception or false statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illegally, fraudulently, or wrongfully obtaining a license required by this chapter by the use of any means, devices, deceptions, or helps in passing any examination or by making false statements or misrepresentations in any applications or information presented

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating §34-23A-10.1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violating §34-23A-10.1

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing medical services declared to have no medical value
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing medical services which have been declared, by declaratory ruling of the board, to be of no medical value

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual activity with patient through exercise of physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The exercise of influence within the physician-patient relationship for the purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity. For the purposes of this subdivision, the patient is presumed incapable of giving free, full, and informed consent to sexual activity with the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or immoral sexual harassment or sexual contact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in gross or immoral sexual harassment or sexual contact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Consistently providing inappropriate or unnecessary medical services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Consistently providing or prescribing medical services or treatments which are inappropriate or unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice or conduct constituting danger to health, welfare, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any practice or conduct which tends to constitute a danger to the health, welfare, or safety of the public or patients or engaging in conduct which is unbecoming a person licensed to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to fulfill obligation to federal or state student loan program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to fulfill a valid obligation to a federal or state student loan or scholarship program for medical school education designed to provide medical services to underserved geographical areas

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territorial, or provincial licensing board or the licensing board of the District of Columbia

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine or osteopathy includes, but not by way of limitation, to append or prefix the letters M.D., or D. O. or the title of Doctor or Dr. or Specialist or Osteopath or any other sign or appellation in a medical sense to one's name or to profess publicly to be a physician or surgeon or to recommend, prescribe or direct for the use of any person any drug, medicine, apparatus, or other agency for the cure, relief or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body or the cure or relief of any wound, fracture or bodily injury or deformity.
definition_quote.quote: practice of medicine or osteopathy includes, but not by way of limitation, to append or prefix the letters M.D., or D. O. or the title of Doctor or Dr. or Specialist or Osteopath or any other sign or appellation in a medical sense to one's name or to profess publicly to be a physician or surgeon or to recommend, prescribe or direct for the use of any person any drug, medicine, apparatus, or other agency for the cure, relief or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body or the cure or relief of any wound, fracture or bodily injury or deformity

methods_authorized.quote: practice medicine or osteopathic medicine, surgery, and obstetrics in all of their branches

drug_authority.value: Prescribe drugs, medicines, and controlled substances as permitted by law
drug_authority.quote: recommend, prescribe or direct for the use of any person any drug, medicine, apparatus, or other agency for the cure, relief or palliation of any ailment or disease

license_status_types.quote: license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine, surgery, and obstetrics in all of their branches, without limitations, in this state

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: If diploma is from medical or osteopathic college outside United States, board may require further proof of competence by rules
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: If the diploma is from a medical or osteopathic college outside the United States, the Board of Examiners may require further proof of competence by rules adopted pursuant to chapter 1-26

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: successful completion of a program as an intern or resident, or of equivalent service approved by the board, in a hospital approved by the board, for such time as the board requires by rule

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Nonresident physicians providing diagnostic or treatment services through electronic means to patients in South Dakota must be under contract with licensed health care provider, clinic, HMO, PPO, or licensed health care facility
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Any nonresident physician or osteopath who, while located outside this state, provides diagnostic or treatment services through electronic means to a patient located in this state under a contract with a health care provider licensed under Title 36, a clinic located in this state that provides health services, a health maintenance organization, a preferred provider organization, or a health care facility licensed under chapter 34-12, is engaged in the practice of medicine or osteopathy in this state

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Judgments or settlements related to malpractice

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every facility licensed by the state where medicine is practiced which suspends or revokes the privilege of a licensee of the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners to practice medicine therein for incompetence or unprofessional conduct as defined in this chapter shall report it in writing to the board

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: A board may conduct, or contract for services with an entity to conduct, a health professionals assistance program to protect the public from impaired persons regulated by the board
impaired_physician_program_authorized.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 02A - Health Professionals Assistance Program] Section 36-2A-2

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens certificate is a certificate allowing the holder thereof to practice medicine in this state for a limited period of time
